subject: Interview today — connection outage and alternate plan
messages:
From: Ethan Rios <ethan.rios@gmail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Interview today — sorry, power outage

Hi Priyom,

I’m really sorry — I lost power in my neighborhood about 20 minutes before our scheduled interview and my phone/laptop are dead. I’m working on finding a place to get power back (coffee shop / neighbor), but I wanted to let you know I won’t be able to join at 1:30pm PT.

If possible, I can try to make a slot later this afternoon (after 5pm PT) or do whatever the team prefers — a recorded coding assessment or reschedule to another day. I’m very interested and don’t want to lose momentum.

Apologies again, and thank you for understanding.

— Ethan
Ethan Rios
Software Engineer
(he/him)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rios <ethan.rios@gmail.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today — sorry, power outage

Hi Ethan — thanks for the heads up and no worries. Hope the outage gets sorted quickly. A couple of options so we can keep momentum: 

- Option A (synchronous): quick 20–30 min phone screen with Jonas at 5:30pm PT today if you’re able to get power back.
- Option B (asynchronous): we can send a short recorded coding exercise you can complete from any device; the panel will review the recording and your code. If the panel wants a follow-up, we’ll schedule a 30-min phone in the next 48 hours.

Attached: recorded_exercise_instructions.pdf and a provisional calendar invite (candidate_calendar_invite.ics). I also attached the version of your resume we have on file.

If you prefer the recorded exercise, say so and I’ll send the submission link now. If you want the 5:30pm slot, please confirm and we’ll lock it in.

Also — quick logistical note: if you end up at a coffee shop, headphones and a quiet corner work best for the phone.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Interview today — sorry, power outage

Quick note from the hiring team side: I’m available to review the recorded exercise this afternoon and can give feedback by EOD. Jonas, I can cover the 5:30pm slot if you’re free, but if any of the engineering panelists need later times (post 7pm) we should probably choose the recorded option to avoid juggling.

If Ethan can do the recorded exercise, we’ll have enough folks to make a decision without rescheduling.

— Mina
Hiring Manager, Backend | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Interview today — sorry, power outage

Hi all — power just came back on, but I’m a bit wary of hopping into a synchronous call in case it drops again. I’d prefer Option B (recorded exercise) if that’s alright — I can complete it and submit within the next 4 hours. If the panel wants to follow up, happy to take a 30-min phone the next day.

Can you send the submission link for the recording and any length/time limits? I saw the instructions PDF but don’t want to miss anything.

Appreciate the flexibility — really excited about this role.

— Ethan
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rios <ethan.rios@gmail.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Interview today — sorry, power outage

Thanks Ethan — totally fine with the recorded exercise. Sending the submission link below. Key details are also in the attached PDF (max 30 minutes of recorded explanation, 90 minutes of coding time, upload the repo + a short mp4 explanation). Please reply to this thread with a timestamped completion note so we have the submission time for the hiring tracker.

Submission link: https://submit.redwood.ai/assignments/abcd-1234 (one-time use)
Deadline: Please submit by 8:30pm PT tonight if possible. If you need more time, tell us and we’ll accommodate — we don’t want to pressure you after an outage.

Next steps: the hiring team will review the recording and code, and we’ll reach back within 48 hours with either a follow-up phone window or a decision. I’ll update the calendar invite to mark the original 1:30pm slot as canceled and leave a tentative slot for a 30-min follow-up if needed.

Thanks again for the quick update — and let us know when you upload.

Best,
Priyom Das
